findings.title: Entering fullscreen restarts the running tour
findings.why_it_matters: Entering fullscreen, rotating a phone, or resizing the viewport during the tour jumps the visitor back to Reception and restarts its entire duration. The camera effect depends on canvas dimensions, but it resets the walking state and replays a tour command even when its ID has already been handled. Preserving elapsed tour state across size changes avoids this unexpected rewind.
findings.suggested_fix: Start a tour only for a newly handled tour command; preserve walking.current and its elapsed time when only canvas dimensions change. Move the unconditional walking reset into actual command/view cancellation handling, and verify fullscreen and resize midway through a tour continue from the current stop.
